a: An argTypes-only arg typed `boolean`, `string` or `enum` gets no control, while one typed `number` does
`weaselforge build --out <root>` still builds into the vite root itself
`sameKnob` treats an `undefined` list member as absent, so `[1, undefined]` equals `[1]` and `[undefined]` equals `[]`
b: describeSchema drops a nested leaf's `encoding`, so the shell refuses or misreads encoded values inside a list, map, object or union
sameKnob ignores array length, so lists that differ only by trailing `undefined` members compare equal
boundsOf drops a valid finite bound when the other one is non-finite
